experienceItems.title: Front-End Developer (Shopify)
experienceItems.description:
TechOps team, remote. DTC health and wellness e-commerce product (NDA). Developed modular product-page buy-box components for bundles, purchase plans, and subscription intervals, and delivered a full product-page redesign.

Migrated analytics to custom Amplitude events across storefront and checkout with Shopify Web Pixels, cross-domain identity stitching, and event schemas designed with product analysts. Built a Cloudflare Workers pipeline for pre-checkout storefront events.

Implemented free-gift eligibility checks and filtered gift items out of Meta Pixel events. Migrated subscriptions from Loop to Recharge, including active subscribers, in coordination with provider support teams.

Built an extension-only Shopify tracking app using a theme app embed and HTML data attributes, tested across multiple stores.

experienceItems.title: Front-End Engineer (Vue / Nuxt, Shopify)
experienceItems.description:
Remote front-end development for e-commerce clients. Built reusable Vue components, Nuxt page layouts, typed TypeScript components, and composables for shared application logic.

Integrated dynamic content and APIs into headless and SSR applications. Customized Shopify themes and built configurable Online Store 2.0 sections and blocks.

Covered components and key flows with unit and E2E tests. Delivered responsive, cross-browser layouts with attention to Core Web Vitals and a modular codebase.

experienceItems.title: Front-End Engineer (Vue / Nuxt, Shopify)
experienceItems.description:
Built reusable UI components and sections with Vue 3, Composition API, and Tailwind CSS for e-commerce interfaces and headless storefronts.

Integrated the Shopify Storefront API into a Nuxt 3 storefront with GraphQL data fetching. Implemented real-time features with WebSockets in a modular Nuxt and Vuex architecture.

Collaborated with backend and UI/UX teams on feature planning and delivery.

experienceItems.title: Frontend Developer (Vue / Nuxt, Shopify)
experienceItems.description:
Built a headless storefront with Nuxt 3, Pinia, and the Shopify Storefront API. Automated product and order synchronization with Google Apps Script, Firebase, and Telegram Bot API.

Delivered 15+ responsive landing pages with Webpack and Gulp, reaching Lighthouse scores of 90+.

Built a Vue and Nuxt marketplace (NDA) with authentication, buyer and seller accounts, product management via REST API, and purchase flows. Developed a legal-support platform (NDA), migrated components to Composition API, and worked with GraphQL and WebSockets.

Migrated a Ukrainian textile store from ASPX to Shopify: imported 1,000+ products, collections, and images with Python and built a custom responsive theme. Launched within 1.5 months; bounce rate dropped by 35% and conversion rate grew by 20%.
